explanation: Track minimum effective purchase prices and best profits for each transaction count. When k cannot restrict the answer, sum positive adjacent gains instead. The unrestricted branch creates price slices.
spaceComplexity: O(k) DP state; O(n) temporary slices in the unrestricted branch
